description_en: Queries the details of an internal-facing access application under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下内网访问应用详情
name: GetPrivateAccessApplication

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the internal-facing access application. You can obtain the value from:
- [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): Lists internal-facing access applications.
- [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): Creates an internal-facing access application.
parameters.description_zh:
内网访问应用ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~)：批量查询内网访问应用。
- [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~)：创建内网访问应用。
